hero.headline: Mocap that lets you keep creating
hero.body: Drop in a photo, video, or webcam — get an editable 3D pose. Built for illustrators, animators, and VTubers who don't want to spend half their day posing reference figures.

problem.headline: Reference posing eats your time.
problem.body: Hunting for the right angle. Posing wooden mannequins. Bending Blender rigs by hand. Every illustration session loses an hour to the same fight — before you make a single mark.

steps.body: SyncRig estimates the 3D pose, frame by frame.

items.title: Drop anything in
items.body: Photo, video file, or live webcam — same tool, same flow. No special rig, no markers.

items.title: Editable 3D pose
items.body: Tweak joints after the solve. Pose-reference for an illustration, or hand it off to your rigging pipeline.

items.title: Runs locally
items.body: Your footage never leaves your machine. No cloud uploads, no account required.

items.title: Blender export
items.body: Send the pose straight to Blender — keyframes intact, ready to clean up or retarget.

items.title: Live VMC streaming
items.body: Broadcast directly to VMC-compatible apps for VTubing, previs, and real-time character work.

items.title: Multi-character
items.body: Track several subjects in one shot for crowd scenes and dialogue sequences.

useCases.headline: Built for the moments you keep losing time to.

items.title: Illustration reference

items.title: VTuber rigging & streaming
items.body: Webcam → live 3D pose → VMC stream. Avatar tracking without a dedicated suit.

items.title: Animation pre-vis
items.body: Block out a shot from a phone video. Send the timeline to Blender for clean-up.

items.title: Research & teaching
items.body: A drop-in mocap baseline for HCI experiments, animation classes, and biomechanics demos.
